rationale: Youth-friendly, modern, community-led, avoiding council-style. Needs electric blue, lime green, and charcoal headings.

grid_patterns.card_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8

cards.base_classes: bg-surface rounded-3xl border border-border overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary_classes: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full font-medium transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-primary/25 hover:shadow-primary/40
buttons.secondary_classes: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground rounded-full font-semibold transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-secondary/25 hover:shadow-secondary/40
buttons.outline_classes: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground rounded-full font-medium transition-all duration-200

badges.default: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold tracking-wider uppercase

header.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/50 transition-all duration-300

ai_upload_feature.classes: relative rounded-3xl p-8 bg-surface border border-primary/20 overflow-hidden
ai_upload_feature.decoration: absolute -inset-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary via-secondary to-accent opacity-20 blur-xl animate-pulse -z-10

interactions_and_motion.page_load: fade-in and slight slide-up (translate-y-4) for hero elements, staggered 100ms
interactions_and_motion.hover: cards lift up, images scale very slightly (scale-105) inside hidden overflow containers

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure secondary (Lime Green) text contrast is handled carefully; use Dark Navy text over Lime Green.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap major animations in matches(prefers-reduced-motion) checks or Tailwind's motion-safe variant.

hero_background.description: Large crowd cheering, youthful energy. Use with a heavy overlay or as part of a bento grid so it doesn't overwhelm text.

event_youth_sports.description: Children playing soccer in a sunny park

event_local_business.description: Coffee shop setting, local business highlight

community_spotlight.description: Two women hugging at an outdoor event, representing community connections.

local_street_venues.description: England village street, use for venue directory or local feed.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install Outfit and Plus Jakarta Sans fonts. Apply the CSS variables in the global styles. Ensure the light/dark mode toggle alters these CSS variables.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react (or phosphor-react) for consistent rounded line icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_execution: Strictly follow the bento grid patterns for the featured events on the homepage. Do not use generic horizontal stripes.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Use Shadcn UI for forms, tabs, and complex logic, but heavily customize them using the provided border-radius (3xl) and colors to strip away the default Vercel-look.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
